description: Odds that a tested driver in a fatal crash died: measured BAC >= .08 and drug positivity, mutually adjusted
population: FARS drivers (PER_TYP 1) of in-transport vehicles in fatal crashes, 2016-2024
outcome: driver killed (vs survived) given a fatal crash
method: Logistic regression, crash-clustered sandwich SEs; covariates: age, sex, vehicle type, crash configuration, night, period
